items.source: Get a LogFile from the given Spring Environment.
items.translation: 从给定的 Spring Environment 获取一个 LogFile。

items.source: A reference to a log output file. Log output files are specified using logging.file.name or logging.file.path Environment properties. If the logging.file.name property is not specified "spring.log" will be written in the logging.file.path directory.
items.translation: 日志输出文件的引用。日志输出文件使用 `logging.file.name` 或 `logging.file.path` Environment 属性指定。如果未指定 `logging.file.name` 属性，则会在 `logging.file.path` 目录中写入 `"spring.log"`。

items.source: Apply log file details to LOG_PATH and LOG_FILE map entries.
items.translation: 将日志文件详情应用于 `LOG_PATH` 和 `LOG_FILE` 映射条目。

items.source: Apply log file details to LOG_PATH and LOG_FILE system properties.
items.translation: 将日志文件详细信息应用于 `LOG_PATH` 和 `LOG_FILE` 系统属性。

items.source:
The name of the Spring property that contains the directory where log files are
written.
items.translation: 包含日志文件写入目录的 Spring 属性名称。

items.source:
The name of the Spring property that contains the name of the log file. Names can
be an exact location or relative to the current directory.
items.translation: 包含日志文件名称的 Spring 属性名称。名称可以是确切的位置或相对于当前目录的路径。

items.source: propertyResolver - the PropertyResolver used to obtain the logging properties
items.translation: propertyResolver - 用于获取日志属性的 PropertyResolver

items.source: a LogFile or null if the environment didn't contain any suitable properties
items.translation: 一个 `LogFile` 或如果环境中不包含任何合适的属性则为 `null`。

items.source: The name of the Spring property that contains the name of the log file.
items.translation: 包含日志文件名称的 Spring 属性名称。

items.source: toString in class Object
items.translation: `toString` 在类 `Object` 中
